name: Mercedes-Benz Group AG
trapType: Capital Penetration & Flagship Margin Hostage Trap (2025 Baseline)
primaryVulnerability: 19.67% Chinese state/private equity capture and disproportionate reliance on China for S-Class and Maybach operating profits
encroachmentSummary: Geely (9.69% via collar options) and BAIC (9.98%) form the combined largest shareholder bloc (19.67%). In 2025, 76.2% (480k units) of China deliveries (630k units) are locally produced at Beijing Benz (BBAC), while 31.5% (€2.4B) of Group EBIT remains dependent on the Chinese market.
localProductionVsSales: In 2025, 480k out of 630k China deliveries are locally assembled at BBAC (76.2% local production ratio).
shareholderStructure: Geely 9.69% + BAIC 9.98% = 19.67% combined stake (commands ~37.5% effective AGM voting power at baseline turnout).
appeasementBehavior: Constrained by Chinese equity capture and flagship margins (S-Class 38%, Maybach 45%), CEO Ola Källenius publicly opposed EU countervailing duties on Chinese EVs and lobbied the German Federal Government against trade defensive measures.

metadata.source: Mercedes-Benz Group AG Annual Report 2024/2025 Guidance / BaFin WpHG §33 Filing

name: Volkswagen AG
trapType: Software Failure & Technological Subcontracting Trap (2025 Baseline)
primaryVulnerability: In-house software division (CARIAD) failure (>€6B cumulative losses) leading to $705M equity investment and CEA zonal E/E architecture licensing from XPENG
encroachmentSummary: China deliveries collapsed by -34.3% (-1.45M units) from 4.23M (2019) to 2.78M (2025). Despite manufacturing 2.58M units locally across ~40 facilities (92.8% localization ratio), VW lost market dominance to BYD and domestic EV champions, forcing it to license software architecture from XPENG as a technological subcontractor.
localProductionVsSales: In 2025, 2.58M out of 2.78M China deliveries are produced domestically across joint venture facilities (92.8% localization ratio).
shareholderStructure: Porsche-Piëch family (53.3%), State of Lower Saxony (20.0%), and Qatar (17.0%) hold voting shares, but operational assets are locked into SAIC and FAW 50:50 joint ventures.
appeasementBehavior: Resisted European de-risking pressures and maintained operations in Xinjiang while committing an additional €2.5B into Hefei VCTC (Volkswagen China Technology Company) under the 'In China for China' banner, accelerating domestic software lock-in.

metadata.source: Volkswagen AG Annual Report 2024/2025 Deliveries / SEC Form 6-K XPENG Inc.

name: BMW Group AG
trapType: Shenyang Mega-Hub Sunk CapEx & Battery Captive Supply Trap (2025 Baseline)
primaryVulnerability: Acquisition of 75% BBA stake (€3.73B) established Shenyang as global export hub for the iX3, creating 100% CATL battery dependency and direct exposure to EU countervailing duties
encroachmentSummary: Shenyang (Tiexi/Dadong) facilities produce 560k units annually (86.2% localization). Deliveries dropped -23.2% from peak (846k in 2021) to 650k in 2025. 100% cell dependency on CATL and EVE Energy for the iX3 and Neue Klasse exposed global exports to EU 20.7% countervailing tariffs.
localProductionVsSales: In 2025, 560k out of 650k China deliveries are manufactured at Shenyang BBA facilities (86.2% localization ratio).
shareholderStructure: Quandt family holds 46.8% voting control, but the €3.73B consolidation of BBA 75% stake concentrated global manufacturing risk inside mainland China.
appeasementBehavior: 100% captive to CATL and EVE Energy battery supply, leaving BMW unable to meet Western origin requirements without relying on Chinese battery gigafactory investments in Hungary.

metadata.source: BMW Group Annual Report 2024/2025 Estimates / Regulation (EU) 2024/2754
